title: Advertisement Sequence
body:
An advertiser has N pairs of events. Each pair u v must be used exactly once, meaning v is advertised directly after u. Build one sequence that starts with the event ABC and uses every pair exactly once.

If several sequences work, print the one that is smallest when compared token by token in alphabetical (ASCII) order. A valid sequence is guaranteed to exist.

Function to complete

Complete adSequence(u, v). It returns the sequence of n + 1 event names.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: The first line contains N. Each of the next N lines contains a pair u v.
out: The sequence of N + 1 event names, separated by spaces.

samples.in:
4
ABC BCD
BCD ABC
EFG ABC
ABC EFG
samples.ex: From ABC, both BCD and EFG are possible, and BCD is smaller. Every pair is used once.

samples.in:
3
ABC A
ABC B
B ABC
samples.ex: Going to A first would get stuck at A with the B pairs still unused.
